description: Switch the shell's active project. Subsequent new chats, scratchpads, todos and pkg installs default to this project; existing project-scoped TanStack queries (sessions, pkgs, todos, scratchpads, cron) refetch automatically. Does NOT navigate panes — pane contents stay put until a phase-2/6-aware surface reads the new active id. Fails if the id is unknown or archived.

id.description: Slug of an existing, non-archived project.

name: iyke_project_set_active
